# Random

[API index](../index.md)

```typescript
function Random(min: number, max: number): number;
```

Return an integer from min inclusive to max exclusive; equal bounds return min.
Reversed bounds or arguments outside signed 32-bit integers throw.

**@keywords**

random, integer, range, exclusive
